entries.question_title: Closed-loop buck converter Vdc from C2 voltage and PWM control
entries.key_topic: Closed-loop buck converter steady-state control calculation
entries.image_storage: Image not stored in GitHub. User keeps image in separate Word document and uses caption in description.md.
entries.caption: Closed-loop buck converter feedback-control case study: the circuit uses a PWM sawtooth comparator, compensator output, and feedback divider to determine the required input voltage Vdc when vC2 = 0.5 V, R12 = 4 kΩ, R13 = 3 kΩ, βVref = 2.5 V, and vsaw = 5 V.
entries.method_summary: Use α=R13/(R12+R13)=3/7, αVo=βVref=2.5 V, so Vo=5.833 V. With vC2=0.5 V, u=3.0 V, δ=u/vsaw=0.6, and Vo=δVdc, giving Vdc=9.72 V.
formula_source: Ideal buck converter relation: Vo = δVdc
Circuit reasoning: feedback divider α = R13/(R12+R13)
